tests.name: asks who pays before validating
tests.prompt: I have an idea for an AI-powered code review tool

assert.description: Should ask who pays or what problem is solved before validating the idea

tests.name: identifies current alternatives
tests.prompt: I want to build a project management tool for freelancers

assert.description: Should ask about or identify current alternatives to the proposed product

tests.name: does bottom-up not top-down sizing
tests.prompt: The market for developer tools is $50 billion. We just need 0.1% to be a $50M company.

assert.description: Should push back on top-down market sizing and ask for bottom-up math

tests.name: generates pre-mortem failure scenarios
tests.prompt: I'm building a SaaS for restaurant owners to manage their menus. $29/month. What could go wrong?

assert.description: Should generate specific failure scenarios, not generic risks

tests.name: asks about distribution
tests.prompt: We've built the product and it's great. Now how do we get customers?

assert.description: Should discuss specific distribution channels, not generic marketing

tests.name: challenges weak pricing
tests.prompt: We'll charge $5/month. It's cheap so everyone will sign up.

assert.description: Should challenge whether $5/month supports viable unit economics

tests.name: steel-mans competition
tests.prompt: There's no real competition in this space. Nobody does exactly what we do.

assert.description: Should push back and identify the real competition (including non-software alternatives)

tests.name: recommends smallest test
tests.prompt: Should I spend 6 months building this before launching?

assert.description: Should recommend the smallest possible test before a 6-month build

tests.name: gives direct verdict
tests.prompt: So what do you think? Should I build this or not?

assert.description: Should give a direct verdict with reasoning, not hedge with 'it depends'

tests.name: scan identifies monetization opportunities
tests.prompt: Scan this project for monetization opportunities. It's an open-source CLI tool with 5,000 GitHub stars.

assert.description: Should identify specific monetization paths for an open-source project
